verdict.rationale: Exa ships a well-documented official MCP server with setup guides for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok and any MCP client, exposing web search, fetching, Exa Agent, and Exa Connect tools; it's open source and requires no API key to start. This is a first-party, dedicated server product (not an agent-client scenario), directly satisfying the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification of the MCP server specifically (community evidence covers the web/search product but not MCP integration experience).
